# Key Technologies.si

> Key Technologies is an AI/SI consulting company run by Shane Christensen, who has more than 42 years of hands-on experience with computers and software, with a background in security, networking and databases. It helps small and mid-sized businesses use AI in practical, safe ways: strategy, automation, AI agents, phone and email assistants, custom software, security and training. Serving Manhattan Beach and Los Angeles, CA and Las Vegas, NV, and working remotely.

Key Technologies does not guarantee results. Interactive demos on this site use made-up data, are not connected to any real system and do not send, book or charge anything.

## Start here
- [Home: services and free website audit](https://keytechnologies.si/): all 23 services, FAQ and contact
- [Book a free call](https://keytechnologies.si/book.html): request a call time (Mon to Fri, Pacific time); nothing is booked until confirmed
- [Interactive demos](https://keytechnologies.si/key-platform/): a demo for each service

## LVR Rewards (Las Vegas Restaurants)
- [LVR Rewards](https://keytechnologies.si/rewards.html): a rewards program for dining at participating Las Vegas restaurants. Rewards are used only for food at participating restaurants and have no cash value.
- [Rewards demo](https://keytechnologies.si/key-platform/demos/rewards.html)
- [Program terms](https://keytechnologies.si/rewards-terms.html) and [privacy](https://keytechnologies.si/rewards-privacy.html)
